bagPolicy.summary: Bags are searched and must fit comfortably under the guest’s seat; oversized bags are prohibited.
allowed: Bag that fits under a seat
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Apollo suggests nearby third-party parking at Park 127th LLC, 340 St Nicholas Avenue, and a garage on West 127th Street; these are not venue-operated.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The visitor page offers transit and taxi directions but does not designate an Apollo rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The Apollo prohibits outside food and beverages and offers accommodations for medical needs on request.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The Historic Theater has 12 orchestra wheelchair seating locations and an elevator to seating levels; contact the box office for assistance. The Historic Theater is closed for renovation with reopening expected in late 2026.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Apollo visitor guidance does not publish a general re-entry policy for performances.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The Apollo lists box office hours Monday through Friday, 10 a.m.–6 p.m., and Saturday, noon–5 p.m., but does not specify a concert will-call pickup procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: All people and bags are searched at entry. The Historic Theater is currently closed for renovation and its visitor page does not publish a universal future concert door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
